question: The power of the President to promulgate ordinance during recess of the parliament is given in which article of the Indian Constitution?
solution:
The correct answer is__** Article 123**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The power of the President to promulgate ordinances during the recess of Parliament is given under Article 123 of the Indian Constitution.
 
• This article grants the President the authority to issue ordinances when either House of Parliament is not in session, provided that immediate action is needed.
 
• The ordinance must be approved by Parliament within six weeks of reassembling.
